file_type: single exact-path regular non-symlink UTF-8 JSONL append-only runtime audit log; not a frozen member
line_format: one canonical JSON object per newline; no duplicate keys, blank lines, invalid UTF-8, invalid JSON or trailing partial line

PREFLIGHT_INVOCATION_REGISTRY_INITIALIZE.cardinality: exactly one, first record only; not a real invocation claim
PREFLIGHT_INVOCATION_REGISTRY_INITIALIZE.constraints: registry_version=2; revision=r11; producer path and digest match current r11 freeze member; freeze path/digest match independently resolved r11; timestamp timezone-aware

PREFLIGHT_INVOCATION_CLAIMED.cardinality: at most one per invocation_id in the entire file; append before connectivity or artifact write
PREFLIGHT_INVOCATION_CLAIMED.constraints: fresh invocation_id; producer and freeze match genesis/current freeze; authorization/attempt/evaluation/benchmark/order match fresh authorization; target equals consumer-computed exact path; timezone-aware timestamp

PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_PERSISTED.cardinality: zero or one per claimed invocation_id; append only after artifact exclusive write and file+directory fsync
PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_PERSISTED.constraints: must follow matching claim; target equals claim/computed target; digest equals actual artifact bytes and explicit consumer SHA; timezone-aware timestamp

PREFLIGHT_INVOCATION_FAILED.cardinality: optional zero or one per claimed invocation_id, only before a persistence event
PREFLIGHT_INVOCATION_FAILED.constraints: sanitized finite stage code, no prompt/API key/secret; terminal and never accepted as a usable preflight

id_and_artifact_binding.artifact_sha_binding: Artifact cannot contain its own SHA. Persistence event records actual artifact SHA after write; formal CLI supplies exact artifact SHA; consumer compares both with bytes read from computed path.

append_only_and_concurrency.initialization: Create new r11 registry exclusively as regular non-symlink file, write genesis newline, fsync file and directory; never edit old r10 registry.
append_only_and_concurrency.claim: Exclusive file lock; strictly parse entire current log and reject malformed/duplicate history; generate/check fresh ID and absent computed target; append claim and fsync before any transport or artifact activity.
append_only_and_concurrency.failure: A claim remains permanently used if transport/artifact/persistence fails or process crashes. Optional failure event may document a known failure but absence of it never restores the ID.
append_only_and_concurrency.persistence: Exclusive artifact write+fsync, then exclusive-locked persistence-event append+fsync; crash between these leaves an artifact without a persistence event and consumer rejects it.
append_only_and_concurrency.consumer: Shared lock; strict parse of full log; exact one claim and one persistence event for ID, no failure event, matching claim-prefix byte length/SHA and artifact digest; no accepted partial or duplicate state.
append_only_and_concurrency.full_file_sha_policy: Do not pin mutable registry full-file SHA in immutable r11 freeze; later valid appends are expected. Pin and verify the claim prefix bytes while also validating the entire later log.

filesystem_boundary: Use exact configured registry path, never glob *.jsonl. AppleDouble ._* companions and unrelated files are not registry inputs; a missing/corrupt canonical registry, symlink, directory, invalid UTF-8/JSON or malformed event fails closed. Never skip a damaged canonical record.
independent_authorities: current r11 freeze and actual member bytes
consumer-computed artifact path and actual bytes
existing frozen formal preflight safety/freshness checks
provenance_limit: Local hashes and append-only checks provide auditable consistency, not cryptographic proof against an actor able to rewrite all local files and reauthorize commands.
